x_failures: Cites Helmont's Origin of Medicine p.299 for the Archeus as a 'master Vulcan' and a 'gift from God' that performs separation; that page is Helmont's attack on Paracelsian tartar and says none of this.
y_failures: Cites Suchten's Antimony p.99 for the claims that a failing Archeus 'fails to separate the pure from the impure' and that tartar coagulates into stones; those pages only say the Archeus cannot make medicine from sulphur or gold, and they mention De Tartaro only as a book title.
reason: Both answers attach at least one claim to a page that doesn't support it. X answers the question better because it draws on Paracelsus's own pages (Paramirum pp.141 and 284, Complete Works p.50), while Y leans on disciples and later authors.
